name: After School Matters (paid apprenticeships and assistantships)
what_you_do: Chicago high schoolers join hands-on programs. Areas include arts, communications and leadership, sports, STEM and skilled trades. You earn a stipend. Most programs need an interview, in person or virtual.
who_can_apply: Must live in the City of Chicago and attend a Chicago high school. Most programs are ages 14 to 18 (14 by Sept 28, 2026 for the fall session). Outreach Assistantships need age 16+.
pay_detail: Paid stipend based on program level and frequency. Dollar amounts vary by program and are not stated on the apply page.
duration: Spring: late Feb to mid May. Summer: late June to early Aug. Fall 2026: Sept 28 to Dec 12.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 application opened Aug 26 and programs started Sept 28; no closing date stated and spaces are limited. Spring 2027 applications open in January; summer 2027 in April (per the session timeline).
how_to_apply: Apply online (up to six programs, ranked). Save your Application ID for the Teen Dashboard. Most programs require an interview; offers must be accepted within 72 hours. A parent/guardian consent form is required after you accept.
notes: One program per session. A Social Security number or ITIN is not required for every program; teens without one should contact ASM. Applying again each session needs a new application. The fall page says the application is open, but programs began Sept 28, so confirm spots remain. Work permit rules for under-16 not stated on ASM pages.
